# Play — Skyline Sums

- SudokuPad: [Skyline Sums on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Skyline Sums on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed) including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
The clues are exported as native f-puzzles `xsum` and `skyscraper` entries (field names as read by the f-puzzles parser in
Rangsk's SudokuSolver, which finds the same unique solution from this exact export without the solution). I have not opened
the links in a browser myself. Some apps draw both clue types as plain numbers, so the rules text lists which clues are
skyscrapers.
Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
